pins.definition: To help someone learn a skill, subject, or language.
To give lessons in a subject at a school, university, or course.
To help someone learn, or to give lessons to someone.

situation: An adult woman teacher stands at the front of a bright classroom of adult students seated at desks, pointing to a large colourful globe on a stand with one hand while explaining with the other raised; the students look up at her with interest. The scene is calm, ordinary and respectful.
subject: a teacher explaining something to a class of adults

prompt: An adult woman teacher stands at the front of a bright classroom of adult students seated at desks, pointing to a large colourful globe on a stand with one hand while explaining with the other raised; the students look up at her with interest. The scene is calm, ordinary and respectful. loose watercolour washes over confident ink linework, blooms and granulation in the pigment, warm paper grain, the warmth of a picture book for adults. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
